segments.sensitive: One reviewer describes sensitive, dry skin and reports burning for hours after each application.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, sensitive skin reports burning on application, while another notes their skin turned drier over years of use and one describes chapping in winter without a moisturizer.
segments.mature: Long-term users in their 40s, 50s, 60s and 70s report continued acne control plus a smoother, less wrinkled, more youthful-looking face over decades of use.
segments.oily: One reviewer says the product controlled her oil and another reports her skin, oily at the start, became drier over years of use.

concerns.spots: Several reviewers report acne clearing or staying controlled, including teens, adults and mature users; four reviewers (teen users and adult sons) report no improvement at all.
concerns.blemishes: Many describe fewer or no new breakouts with consistent use, including during hormonal periods and postpartum; a few teen users' parents report no visible change and one adult reports occasional itching.
concerns.aging: Long-term mature users report their skin looks younger, smoother and less wrinkled after years of use, crediting it as an unintended anti-aging benefit.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer needed extra moisturizer in winter to avoid chapping, and one long-term user noticed her oily skin became drier over the years; another says it keeps skin from feeling dry.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive, dry skin reports burning and irritation lasting hours after application, contrasting with the general lack of complaints from others.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the product controlling facial oil and leaving skin non-oily, with no dissent reported on this specific point.
concerns.barrier: One sensitive/dry-skin reviewer reports burning suggesting irritation of a compromised barrier, though most other reviewers do not report this issue.

aspects.libelle: Requires consistent daily use to work

extraits.texte: I have been using a 2.5% BP spot treatment from another brand and wanted to find something more cost effective. I didn't realize that Proactiv had multiple BP products for different skin types. I'm sensitive and dry but have lots of acne around my chin and mouth. I put a small amount of this product in the morning, and I have used it 3 days so far (every other day), and there is burning on my skin for several hours after applying. I am bummed that this formula will not work for me as the other brand I was using had no burning.

extraits.titre: Kills acne quickly and prevents future breakouts
extraits.texte: Much clearer than I was before this! I used to use this in my 20s and it kept my acne under control. I had straight away from it because it was bleaching my clothes and sheets. . however I started breaking out really bad after having babies and decided to go back to my old faithful. So glad I did because I get compliments all the time at 42 that I look way younger. This is definitely my favorite part of the three system because I know after I put this on, I won't wake up with new breakouts and I can put make up on top of it and it will protect my skin from breakouts from the make up. It definitely controls my oil, although I have to be careful to not put it around my eyes too much. I also have to wear the proactive sunscreen on top of it if I go in the sun. There is nothing better than this formulation anything with less percentage of benzoyl peroxide is too weak and anything stronger is too strong. I love it. Now I am just really careful not to put it near my neck line if I'm wearing something I don't want to get bleached and I have white sheets.

I have used the Repair lotion for more than 40 years. I initially used it as very successful acne control and continued to use it as a skin moisturizer to prevent wrinkles. My daughter recently told me that I do not look my age. I will be 75 this year.
This product is excellent ! It works well on adult acne too. Be careful to use a good moisturizer in the winter months otherwise you may experience chapping.
It has worked for me for years. My skin was oily when I started using Proactive, but over the years It has become drier.
I had high hopes for this product to be the miracle we needed - but it wasn't. It didn't help with the acne at all.
I absolutely love this product. I had a lot of texture around my mourn. My skin was very irritated. This product worked with in days.
